title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. As salaam u alaikum Please help me on the following queries 1) Is family planning allowed in Islaam as to using of contraceptives, condoms etc 2) is colouring of hair allowed or disallowed in Islaam 3)If some drop of urine still remains in the undergarments inspite of taking all the precautionary measures what shuld one do, as I have heard that we can put some water on it. 4)Is insurance allowed in Islaam and to what extent and can I Invest in Life Insurance of mutual funds or shares. 2785 views Q. I want to know 1- How to calculate Zakat on CPF( Central Provident Fund),CPF is like Employee Provident Fund.In CPF amount will be deposited from Employee salary deduction and company contribution. And CPF will be given at the time of retirement a) I understand Zakat is payable when we possess the money, Shall we calculate the zakat for all those year when money was getting deposited or for the year when we get the money ?? 2- How to calculate Zakat on Insurance Policies which will get mature in 25 years time (if I withdraw from policy no return will be given.)?Shall we pay zakat for every annual premium or only for the year when we get the money ? 3- How to calculate Zakat for Life Time policy( In life time policy fund will be invested in market and value can increase and decrease depending on market conditions), maturity date is after 25 years.This type of Policy has some surrender value if I want to withdraw from the policy. Do we need to pay when policy get mature or we are suppose to pay each year on surrender value or we need to pay at the time of maturity for every year. 4-Can we generalize the method of calculation for all the savings and Investments which get locked for certain period ? Should we calculate Zakat at the time of maturity of policy(liquidation of Investment) for that year only ?? or we should calculate zakat for all the previous year ?? or Shall we calculate each year? 3942 views Q. I recently attended a wedding at at the end a few brothers were called to the stage to take photographs. Some people were using their mobiles to take photos, some people digital cameras and their was a video camera too. A brother advised us that we should avoid posing for these photos but he did not give a reason as he was not 100% sure on the ruling. A few other brothers said they will only be saving these on their mobiles and not publishing them in anyway and some simply said there is nothing wrong and that the ruling was for something in the past about idol worshiping and that they will not be using to idol worship. Can you please advise on the correct ruling on this issue and please send me some hadith and Quran aayaats which help to convince everyone either way. May ALLAH reward you all for your efforts and may ALLAH make the academy a source of knowledge for all. please rememeber me in your duas. 4146 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 15386 Country: United States of America Title: Dear Mufti sahab, AssalamoAlaikum wa rehma I am living in florida(America)with my husband .we are running a jewelry buisness ,most of our stuff is saleeb(cross)and items of christian religion which are the most selling item in the market our financial situation is not very good .My question to you is selling of cross(saleeb)as pendants and other jewelry is permitted in islam or not please tell me .and my husband is saying what is the alternative way .AssalamoAlaikum wa rehma Question: Dear Mufti sahab, AssalamoAlaikum wa rehma I am living in florida(America)with my husband .we are running a jewelry buisness ,most of our stuff is saleeb(cross)and items of christian religion which are the most selling item in the market our financial situation is not very good .My question to you is selling of cross(saleeb)as pendants and other jewelry is permitted in islam or not please tell me .and my husband is saying what is the alternative way .AssalamoAlaikum wa rehma Answer ID: 15386 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1438/1366=B=1430) Cross is purely a Christian?s religious emblem, therefore a Muslim is not allowed to deal in such an item. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
